acceptance: Add only the fixed parameterless evidence-validator focused_check capability with the literal identifier evidence-validator-focused-suite and a code-owned enumerated deterministic local test set.

Use fixed argv, timeout, bounded stdout/stderr, and minimal environment policy; fail closed on unavailable inputs, launch errors, nonzero exit, timeout, stream errors, or truncation; do not accept caller-selected commands, paths, arguments, globs, environment, cwd, provider, session, or shell input.

Wire the evidence-validator profile to exactly read,grep,find,ls,git_inspect,focused_check while preserving same-worktree, no-session, no-approval, no-skills, no-extension, capability-based dispatch, diagnostic caller metadata, and existing git_inspect behavior.

Validate launcher/profile/extension behavior, deterministic focused-check behavior, package build, task-record/content/JSON/whitespace/diff checks, and no role-contract or unrelated behavior changes; no descendants are authorized.
